cohort: 100 children under 5 years old hospitalized with ALRI and 100 healthy newborns from immunization and well-baby clinics in Mumbai, India
finding: Risk factors for ALRI in children under 5 include lack of immunization, improper breastfeeding and weaning, poor living conditions and malnutrition, prematurity, and cesarean birth, with the first year of life being the most susceptible period.
mod_finding: Cesarean birth was identified as a risk factor for ALRI.
